别名

  • Immoral Byoutou

あらすじ

Iwasaki Takuya wakes up in the hospital after an accident. His sister-in-law Haruka was working there as a nurse. The doctor in charge of him was Reika, an older sister from his old neighborhood, one he had longed for a long time.

During his stay he met another patient Saya, who had been hospitalised for a long time. He also met Saya’s mother Kaname, working at a coffee shop near the hospital.

别名

  • Musu Make

あらすじ

One night while on an expedition, alchemist Oto finds a small wounded dragonling in a cave full of blooming flowers. He tends to the beast and while preparing to leave also stumbles upon a shining crystal which he takes with him for further research.

The same night he dreams about his late wife who passed on still bearing their unborn child, Natane. “Please take care of our daughter”, he hears before being woken up by a baby in a basket. The crystal had turned into a healthy child!

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ILLUSION
  • 発売日: 1996-09-13
  • スコア: 5.85/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 漂流
  • 英語名: Hyouryuu

あらすじ

It’s the end of 21st century. Five high-school youngsters are out camping near Tokyo. Suddenly, they are transported into a different place. It looks like a jungle. It’s very hot. And it’s certainly not Japan. As the heroes investigate the surroundings, they realize that they were taken to Lagoon Republic, a mysterious independent country on a tropical island that has been the home of a bizarre incident over seventy years ago. Now the young people have to find the truth behind their presence in Lagoon, and to solve the mystery of the island, while avoiding the dangers that await them.

あらすじ

The protagonist of the game is an ordinary Japanese man who lives together with his pretty wife Harunako. Two years after their marriage, they decided to move into an apartment in the suburbs. Everything seems normal when the couple arrives. But very quickly they both become involved in sexual intrigues, and witness strange events - mostly of sexual nature - that occur in the presence of their neighbors. Looks like the quiet family life they were hoping for will never become reality…

  • 英語名: Onigashirajima Joshi Keimusho

别名

  • Kitoushima Joshi Keimusho

あらすじ

On a secluded island known as Onigashira stands a prison for women. In this prison, inmates are being methodically raped and tortured by wardens. The player is invites to witness the events that take place in the prison from the point of view of five characters: two prisoners, the lovely 23-year-old Chika Kanzawa and the innocent teenager Miki; the sadistic female warden Enko, the police officer Otonashi Youichirou, and a mysterious man known as Seiki, who has his own agenda.

item.title: Yami no Ryousen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ILLUSION
  • 発売日: 1994-03-25
  • スコア: 5.86/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 闇の稜線
  • 英語名: Yami no Ryousen

あらすじ

A car fell from the cliff and its driver is heavily wounded. He lies on the side of the cliff bleeding and awaiting his last seconds to tick. The driver wakes up in the house bandaged, but with a light memory loss. He was found and helped by a local family. First thing he gets to remember is that he went on a trip to ask Mayumi’s father for marriage permission. But at the moment that he arrived, villa got attacked. Mayumi was raped and killed. He discovers from the newspaper that he is the main suspect and now it’s the time to go undercover and find out the truth.
